title: Apple Mail data
whyItMatters: Mail keeps local copies of messages, attachments and account settings. A new owner could read correspondence that was never deleted.
source: macforensics.app cheat sheet (Apple Mail); Apple lists ~/Library/Mail among folders that need Full Disk Access
notes: TCC-protected: without Full Disk Access the folder returns 'Operation not permitted' on a live system. Mailboxes are counted, never read. Reviewed in W3-D2 (independent review, docs/research/macos-review.md).
